description: This file defines the Subscription model class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, managing database interactions related to customer subscriptions, including retrieving subscription details, histories, associated products, options, and counts.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: A class handling database operations for customer subscriptions within the Opencart platform, including methods to retrieve subscription data, histories, counts, and related entities.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subscription record by ID for the current customer, decoding payment and shipping methods if available.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscription records for the current customer with optional pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscriptions for the current customer.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionByShippingAddressId
methods.description: Counts subscriptions associated with a specific shipping address ID.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionByPaymentAddressId
methods.description: Counts subscriptions associated with a specific payment address ID.

methods.name: getProductByOrderProductId
methods.description: Fetches a subscription product record based on order ID and order product ID.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products linked to a particular subscription.

methods.name: getTotalProducts
methods.description: Counts the number of products associated with a subscription.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Fetches options for a subscription and a specific subscription product.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves subscription history entries with optional pagination.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts total history entries for a specific subscription.
